title: Herr Korbes
summary: A rooster and a hen traveled in a miniature carriage to visit Herr Korbes, accompanied by a cat, an egg, a duck, a pin, and a needle....
full_text:
A rooster and a hen traveled in a miniature carriage to visit Herr Korbes, accompanied by a cat, an egg, a duck, a pin, and a needle.

Herr Korbes was a grumpy, wicked man who hated living creatures.

When he returned home, the cat threw ashes in his eyes; the duck splashed him with water; the egg burst in his face; the needle pricked his towel; the pin stuck his chair; and when he ran for the door, the rooster dropped a heavy stone on his head!

Truly, Herr Korbes must have been a terribly bad man to deserve such a reception from common household things!
moral: Those who make themselves odious to all find every household utensil turned against them.

quiz.question: What is the central moral lesson taught in "Herr Korbes"?
options: Presence of mind and quiet wisdom triumph over brute strength.
Acting in haste and anger without thinking
Believing rumors and flattery without proof
quiz.hint: Remember the moral lesson of this traditional story.

quiz.question: How do the characters overcome their challenge?
options: Through patience, calm reflection, and wisdom
By shouting loudly and blaming others
By running away from every problem
quiz.hint: Consider the virtues praised in world folklore.

quiz.question: What memorable conclusion does this story teach young readers?
options: Honesty, kindness, and clear thinking lead to peace
quiz.hint: Reflect upon the resolution of the story.
